newsitem.title: CANADA: Barrick says share option oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Barrick says share option oversubscribed.

text.p: Barrick Gold Corp said Tuesday that shareholders of its takeover target Arequipa Resources Ltd oversubscribed to Barrick's share option.
Barrick said it will pay C$512 million in cash and issue a total of 13.4 million shares to complete the takeover of Arequipa, a junior gold exploration company.
A total of 93 percent of Arequipa shareholders tendered their shares to Barrick on Monday night in response to its offer of C$30 cash or part cash, part shares.
Because the share-and-cash option was oversubscribed, only 72 percent of the tendered shares will receive the option.

Shareholders who chose to receive the share and cash option will receive 0.79 Barrick share plus 50 cents for every Arequipa share for the first 72 percent of their holdings and C$30 a share for the remainder.
Barrick put a cap on the number of shares that would be offered. But since Arequipa shareholders' demand for shares surpassed Barrick's limit, Barrick pro-rated the share offer.

The company said it will exercise its right to buy all the remaining shares of Arequipa. When all is said and done, the share issue will bump up the total number of Barrick shares outstanding by about 3.9 percent, spokesman Vince Borg said.
